verdict.rationale: Gumloop is a SaaS agent platform, so offering an official MCP server that external agents connect to is a fair question. However, the evidence shows only client-side MCP support (its agents connecting to any MCP server, plus proxied external servers) and Hosted MCPs, which deploy customer-written servers on Gumloop's infrastructure. Neither is a first-party Gumloop MCP server, and the probe pointing to the custom_mcp_servers page describes client-side connection, so no official server is evidenced.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
